transparent_criteria: No daily progress logged in >X days

daily_progress_update.comments: Persistent classmate & mentor commenting thread with full authorization and deletion support

daily_progress_update.attachment_limit: 2 MB maximum • JPG, PNG, WebP, PDF only

weekly_formal_report.mentor_review_queue: Dedicated mentor review queue with filter tabs: All Submitted, Pending Review, Approved, Needs Revision
weekly_formal_report.mentor_evaluation: Persistent feedback remarks with status decision toggle (Approved vs Needs Revision)
weekly_formal_report.resubmission_policy: Students with 'needs_revision' status have a 1-click Revise & Resubmit workflow
weekly_formal_report.attachment_limit: 2 MB maximum • JPG, PNG, WebP, PDF proof sheets
weekly_formal_report.isolation: Classmates cannot view other students' weekly reports or mentor evaluations

student_profile_photo.compression_engine: Iterative HTML5 canvas WebP/JPEG compression in src/utils/imageUtils.ts
student_profile_photo.cleanup: Automatic removal of unreferenced previous avatar files
